requirements.text: The system must allow customers to book appointments online.
The system must allow customers to change or cancel their appointments without calling.
The system must allow customers to select a service when making a booking.
The system must allow customers to choose a barber when making a booking.
The system must display available times for appointments after selecting a service and barber.
The system must include services like haircuts and beard trims.
Barbers must be able to set and update their own availability.
The system must ensure that double bookings are avoided.
The booking system must keep everything organized.
